activeTask.title: Build WAKE Engine V6 into an elite operator app
activeTask.objective: Turn source, chat, agents, clusters, and exports into one coherent task-completion system.
activeTask.nextAction: Use Console or section chat to advance the current ask.

tasks.title: Source prompt builder
tasks.detail: Turns pasted source into a structured WAKE frame with role, objective, scenes, hooks, constraints, and output contract.

tasks.title: Tier Zero content agents
tasks.detail: Runs source-driven agent tools, A2A handoffs, local memory, quality gates, and optional local Ollama generation.

tasks.title: Snapshot storage
tasks.detail: Saves the current source, output, runtime status, and capability map to local application data.

tasks.title: Task monitor scaling
tasks.detail: Bounded, searchable, filterable task surface so the list does not grow forever.

tasks.title: Content Cluster creation network
tasks.detail: Creates campaign packets, platform lanes, scripts, visual prompts, evidence packs, distribution plans, and export bundles.

tasks.title: Local export writer
tasks.detail: Writes markdown and JSON exports under local application data.

tasks.title: Local memory ledger
tasks.detail: Persists projects, sources, generations, exports, and history in the local WAKE store.

tasks.title: System monitor
tasks.detail: Samples CPU, RAM, GPU, runtime, and local action logs.

capabilities.label: Ingest & Parse
capabilities.detail: Accepts pasted source text and turns it into structured frame fields.

capabilities.label: Tier Zero Content Agent Runtime
capabilities.detail: Runs the promoted Wake Engine Tier Zero content agents with contracts, local tools, A2A handoffs, memory receipts, and QA output.

capabilities.label: Agent Chat Console
capabilities.detail: Chats with verified content agents, retrieves local context, streams fast deterministic draft first, then upgrades with Ollama when reachable.

capabilities.label: IP / Media Intake Agent
capabilities.detail: Scans configured local folders for text, docs, images, audio, video, and source metadata.

capabilities.label: Content Cluster Builder
capabilities.detail: Locally groups any source into pillars, output lanes, proof notes, and handoff drafts.

capabilities.label: Snapshot Storage
capabilities.detail: Writes auditable JSON snapshots to the local repo runtime folder.

capabilities.label: Script & Structure Agent
capabilities.detail: Frames scenes, hooks, captions, titles, platform blocks, CTAs, claim maps, and edit rules from source.

capabilities.label: Local Distribution Pack
capabilities.detail: Exports reviewed outputs as local markdown and JSON files.

capabilities.label: Local Memory Ledger
capabilities.detail: Persists projects, sources, generations, exports, snapshots, and action history in Electron userData.

capabilities.label: GPU / System Monitor
capabilities.detail: Samples CPU, RAM, GPU counters, process uptime, port, and local action logs.
